dedupe_keys.name: atlantic council central bank digital currency cbdc tracker

description: An interactive tracker of central bank digital currency projects worldwide. The Atlantic Council page says 146 countries and currency unions, representing over 98 per cent of global GDP, are exploring a CBDC, and shows each country's status on a map, cross-border CBDC projects with their participants and use cases, a timeline of countries exploring CBDCs and the CBDCs in circulation; it was last updated in May 2026. It is free to use in a browser. Coverage is global, by country and currency union. Caveats: status categories are the Council's own and the page read offers no download or licence. For simulation it shows which countries are building new retail or wholesale payment rails, which change how payment systems may fail or be restored in a crisis. A related catalogue record is the BIS CPMI red book payment statistics.
